timingDefinition: HTTP includes client serialization, local loopback, server transaction and complete bounded body read; durable timing additionally includes independent observer queue and SELECT.
harnessOverhead: 25 workers, one independent observer connection, bounded HTTP response hashing and append-only evidence writes share this PC; durability timing includes observer queue, while evidence archival occurs after timing.
limits: 25 synthetic actors on one Windows PC, not 25 people/devices
No restart, power-loss, production, independent monitor or backup claim
Warmup, support reads, preparation, failures and reconciled commits excluded from successful write latency percentiles; failures remain visible
No SQL mutations or automatic uncertain HTTP retries
